summary: This study compares the drug HRS-7535 with dapagliflozin in adults who have type 2 diabetes, a condition with high blood sugar, and whose blood sugar is not well controlled by metformin. A total of 810 participants joined the research to see how well the treatments work. The study is now Completed. Shandong Suncadia Medicine Co., Ltd. is the sponsor for this clinical trial.
